changes.title: Change Management
changes.description: IT/OT change requests with risk assessment and approval workflow. Supports NIS2 Art. 21(2)(e).
changes.helpText: Track all changes to IT and OT systems through a formal approval process. Each change request includes risk assessment, implementation plan, and rollback procedure. NIS2 requires controlled change management to prevent security regressions.
changes.empty: No change requests yet. Create your first change request.
changes.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this change request?

fieldDescriptions.title: Short descriptive title for this change request (e.g., 'Upgrade firewall firmware to v4.2').
fieldDescriptions.description: Detailed description of the proposed change, including affected systems and expected outcome.
fieldDescriptions.changeType: Select the type: standard (pre-approved, low risk), normal (requires review), or emergency (urgent, post-approval).
fieldDescriptions.status: Current status of the change request in the approval and implementation workflow.
fieldDescriptions.createdAt: Date when this change request was submitted.
fieldDescriptions.businessJustification: Explain why this change is necessary, including business drivers and security benefits.
fieldDescriptions.securityImpactAssessment: Describe the potential security impact of this change, including risks introduced or mitigated.
fieldDescriptions.rollbackPlan: Describe the steps to revert this change if implementation fails or causes unexpected issues.
